title: Signal Station
author: Luke Steuber
description:
Chat from your wrist with the language model you choose. Press the middle right button to dictate, Up to capture selected readings, and Down for recent history. The phone keeps full conversations and observations.

Requires the separate Signal Station Android app alongside your usual Pebble app. Add your own provider key for chat; captures need no key. Dictation depends on watch support. Still in testing.

By Luke Steuber.
releaseNotes: Clear side-button labels for Capture, Ask and History, plus watch motion and health-history collection. The backlight stays on while the app is visible. Requires the separate Signal Station Android app; still in testing.
physicalValidation: Prior Time 2 / Pixel 9a capture evidence; no new physical-device run during this Store publication.
